species.name: Trout
why: Water 45°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 8–16 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.

species.name: Walleye
why: Water 45°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 8–34 ft deep, mostly on flats.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
